channel.title: KhingPaste
channel.description: Update feed for KhingPaste, the macOS clipboard history app.

item.description:
KhingPaste can now update itself.

New

  • Updates arrive in the app. KhingPaste checks once a day in the background

and offers the new version when there is one. Check for Updates… is in the menu bar, and Settings → Updates shows the running version, when it last checked, and a switch for the daily check.

  • A scheduled check never interrupts a history panel you have open. One you ask

for always runs.

Changed

  • KhingPaste now ships as a signed, notarised disk image rather than a zip.

Drag it to Applications the usual way.

  • Universal build: Apple silicon and Intel in one download.
